categories: 断言有效性-预期结果不完整

defense_dimensions.name: 辅助函数内聚断言
defense_dimensions.description: 断言逻辑封装在专用辅助/校验函数中，并非空断言或无断言

defense_dimensions.name: 无异常即成功契约
defense_dimensions.description: 用例旨在验证操作不抛出异常或安全兜底，无需显式 ASSERT

defense_dimensions.name: 存根契约覆盖
defense_dimensions.description: Mock 或 Stub 的调用期望本身构成隐式逻辑检验

description: 以单个测试用例为最小单位，深度审计其断言有效性、提前返回、空测试等，评估每个用例是否真实独立地校验了业务逻辑
name: ut_effectiveness

categories.label: 无问题
categories.definition: The test case independently verifies meaningful behavior and has no material effectiveness defect.
decision_rules: mocks and setup match the contract

categories.label: 断言有效性-空测试
categories.definition: A test case performs no meaningful assertion or verification.
decision_rules: test can pass without executing behavior
positive_hints: helper or implicit expectation verifies behavior

categories.label: 断言有效性-预期结果不完整
categories.definition: The test verifies only part of the required outcome or state.
decision_rules: side effect or error path is ignored
negative_hints: remaining behavior is covered by another test

categories.label: 断言有效性-永真断言
categories.definition: An assertion or condition can pass regardless of the behavior under test.
decision_rules: condition mirrors the input or implementation tautologically
assertion is on an unchanged default
negative_hints: test explicitly checks a non-throwing contract

categories.label: 断言有效性-无效捕获
categories.definition: The test fails to capture the exception, result, callback, or state needed for verification.
decision_rules: expected failure or callback is not captured
negative_hints: side effect is unnecessary by contract

categories.label: 断言有效性-Mock遗漏
categories.definition: A collaborator interaction required by the test contract is not mocked, verified, or controlled.
decision_rules: external or expensive dependency is invoked
positive_hints: stub or mock controls the dependency

categories.label: 提前返回-非法退出
categories.definition: A test exits through return, throw, or abort before completing its intended verification.
decision_rules: early path is taken for invalid setup
cleanup or result evaluation is lost
positive_hints: early return expresses the completed contract

categories.label: 提前返回-静默跳过
categories.definition: A test is skipped or neutered without an actionable reason or tracking.
decision_rules: skip is unconditional or overly broad
no ticket or environment rationale exists

categories.label: 功能单一性-面条测试
categories.definition: One test case verifies too many unrelated behaviors or scenarios.
decision_rules: failure cannot identify the violated behavior

categories.label: 功能单一性-路径混合
categories.definition: Success and failure paths are mixed in one test and obscure the verified contract.
decision_rules: happy and error cases are interleaved

categories.label: 其它
categories.definition: A credible test-effectiveness risk that does not fit a more specific controlled category.
